_comment: Schema reference for backend-only refund_requests/{jobId}. One deterministic Phase 4 no-driver refund-initiation operation exists per job; signed Phase 3 refund.processed handling remains final provider reconciliation and must gain the locked Stage 9 convergence transaction before launch.
_spec_ref: docs/phase4_decisions.md P4-D025, P4-D026, P4-D031, P4-D036, P4-D038, P4-D039, P4-D041, P4-D042 and §refund_requests/{jobId}
_invariants: Document ID and operationId equal jobId. The source job must be cancelled_system with cancelledBy=system and cancellationReason=no_driver_found. amountPaise is a positive safe integer exactly equal to immutable jobs/{jobId}.bookingFeePaise. razorpayPaymentId, amountPaise, reason, providerIdempotencyKey, and providerRequestHash are immutable after creation. Every initiation attempt sends X-Refund-Idempotency with the exact stored providerIdempotencyKey and uses the identical payment, amount, canonical request body, and hash. A submitted request remains durably scheduled for provider reconciliation until confirmed; provider errors are reduced to safe operational codes, and raw bodies, secrets, and unrelated payment metadata are forbidden.

_state_machine.signedWebhookTransition: A valid matching signed refund.processed event may move any non-confirmed state to confirmed, including when it arrives before worker success persistence or after a provider fetch reported failed. confirmed is absorbing and never regresses.
_state_machine.ownership: in_progress initiation and due submitted reconciliation use non-null ownerToken and leaseUntil fencing. A submitted reconciler claims without changing state; stale initiation or reconciliation ownership is reclaimable.
_state_machine.terminality: confirmed is final provider-processed convergence. failed_terminal is a local no-retry classification but a later valid signed provider webhook for the same exact provider refund identity still converges it to confirmed.

_provider_request_contract.storedAmountBinding: bookingFeePaise equals immutable refund request amountPaise
_provider_request_contract.retryInvariant: every attempt sends header X-Refund-Idempotency with the exact stored providerIdempotencyKey and reuses the same payment, amount, canonical request, and hash; no attempt or worker identity

_submitted_reconciliation_contract.preferredConfirmation: A valid matching signed refund.processed webhook is the preferred confirmation path but is not the only durable path.
_submitted_reconciliation_contract.claim: A transaction leaves state=submitted, requires razorpayRefundId, sets a fresh ownerToken/leaseUntil, and permits reclaim only when leaseUntil is absent or expired.
_submitted_reconciliation_contract.providerLookup: GET payments/{razorpayPaymentId}/refunds/{razorpayRefundId} using only the immutable stored payment and refund identities; no raw provider response is persisted.
_submitted_reconciliation_contract.processedResult: A matching processed result transactionally sets request and job projections to confirmed, sets confirmationSource=reconciliation, clears both retry schedules and owner/lease, and preserves immutable inputs.
_submitted_reconciliation_contract.pendingResult: A matching pending result keeps state=submitted, increments reconciliationAttempts, writes a bounded reconciliationNextAttemptAt, clears owner/lease, and never creates or resubmits a refund.
_submitted_reconciliation_contract.uncertainResult: Provider unavailability or an uncertain fetch keeps state=submitted, increments reconciliationAttempts, records only a bounded safe lastErrorCode and reconciliationNextAttemptAt, clears owner/lease, and never creates or resubmits a refund.
_submitted_reconciliation_contract.failedResult: An authoritative provider response returning status=failed where paymentId, refundId, and amount match stored identities transactionally moves state submitted->failed_terminal, persists a bounded safe failure classification in lastErrorCode, clears ownerToken, leaseUntil, and reconciliationNextAttemptAt/nextAttemptAt, and updates the matching job refundState=failed_terminal and refundNextAttemptAt=null while preserving jobId, razorpayPaymentId, razorpayRefundId, amountPaise, providerIdempotencyKey, and providerRequestHash. failed_terminal does not become confirmed from the fetch that reported failed, does not automatically submit a second refund, does not reset to pending/submitted through ordinary retry, and requires an explicit future administrative/manual recovery operation if recovery is needed.
_submitted_reconciliation_contract.failedTerminalResult: failed_terminal is a durable local no-retry classification and is NOT queried by ordinary reconcilers or workers. A reconciler MUST NOT attempt provider fetch against a failed_terminal request. However, a later valid matching signed refund.processed webhook for the exact same provider refund identity still converges failed_terminal to confirmed with confirmationSource=webhook, confirmedAt, job refundState=confirmed, refundConfirmedAt, and refundedAmountPaise, preserving all immutable payment/refund/request identities. Ordinary retry cannot reset failed_terminal to pending/submitted.
_submitted_reconciliation_contract.mismatchResult: Any payment, refund ID, amount, operation, reason, or job identity mismatch fails closed without confirmation or resubmission.
_submitted_reconciliation_contract.raceConvergence: Webhook and provider-fetch confirmation re-read the request and job in their transaction; the first matching path confirms them and the loser becomes an identity-validating no-op.
_submitted_reconciliation_contract.absorbingState: confirmed never regresses, never re-enters reconciliation, and never causes a duplicate provider submission.

_monotonic_convergence: The no-driver domain transaction creates exactly refund_requests/{jobId} and sets job refundRequestId=jobId, refundState=pending, refundNextAttemptAt, cancelledBy=system, cancellationReason=no_driver_found, and cancelledAt atomically.
Before any external request, deterministic providerIdempotencyKey, providerRequestHash, razorpayPaymentId, amountPaise, and reason are durable.
A worker claim moves pending or retry_wait to in_progress using fenced owner/lease semantics without changing immutable provider inputs.
If provider success persistence is lost, recovery repeats the identical request body and sends X-Refund-Idempotency with the exact stored providerIdempotencyKey.
Worker success persists submitted, razorpayRefundId, submittedAt, reconciliationNextAttemptAt, and the matching job refundState=submitted before relying on the webhook.

A reclaimable submitted reconciler fetches the stored payment/refund identity: a matching processed result confirms the refund, a matching failed result marks it failed_terminal, and a matching pending/unavailable result durably reschedules without provider resubmission.

Stage 9 signed refund.processed handling must transactionally validate payment, amount, refund identity, reason, request/job identity, then set both request and job projections to confirmed even if the webhook arrived before worker success persistence or after a provider fetch reported failed.
Webhook and provider-fetch confirmation race safely: the first matching transaction confirms, the other validates identity and becomes a no-op.
confirmed never regresses or resubmits; any payment, amount, refund ID, operation, reason, job, or immutable-request mismatch fails closed.

operationId.description: Deterministic semantic no-driver refund identity; exactly jobId.

providerIdempotencyKey.description: Durable before the first external attempt and reused unchanged for every retry as the exact value of request header X-Refund-Idempotency. Firestore auto IDs satisfy the jobId alphabet; any nonconforming ID fails closed. It never includes attempt number or worker identity.

providerRequestHash.format: lowercase 64-character SHA-256 hex of UTF-8 canonicalRefundRequest
providerRequestHash.description: canonicalRefundRequest is exactly JSON.stringify({ paymentId: razorpayPaymentId, amount: bookingFeePaise }) with that construction/key order and no optional or undefined fields; bookingFeePaise equals immutable stored amountPaise. The Razorpay body itself contains only amount.

reconciliationNextAttemptAt.description: Due time for reclaimable provider-status reconciliation while state=submitted; cleared on confirmed.

reconciliationAttempts.description: Count of provider-status fetch attempts only; never affects the immutable provider submission identity.

razorpayRefundId.description: Required for submitted and confirmed; immutable once known. A different webhook refund ID fails closed.

confirmationSource.description: Null before confirmation; set exactly once by the matching path that first commits confirmed.

lastErrorCode.description: Bounded safe operations code only; no raw body, secret, stack trace, or customer metadata.

submittedAt.description: Provider refund identity persistence time; required in submitted/confirmed when worker success was persisted, but may remain null if the signed webhook wins first.

confirmedAt.description: Required only in confirmed. Set exactly once by the first matching path that commits confirmed — either a valid matching signed refund.processed webhook (confirmationSource=webhook) or a due reconciler fetching a processed result (confirmationSource=reconciliation). Never regresses.
